description: Implementation of a hierarchically-organized range map with methods for storing, retrieving, and clearing ranges, used internally in the Google Breakpad project.

classes.name: ContainedRangeMap
classes.description: A template class implementing a hierarchical range map for address ranges.

methods.name: ~ContainedRangeMap
methods.description: Destructor that clears the range map and frees resources.

methods.name: StoreRange
methods.description: Stores a range specified by base address, size, and associated entry, with containment checks.

methods.name: RetrieveRange
methods.description: Retrieves the entry associated with a given address if contained within stored ranges.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all stored ranges and deallocates resources.
